subject: Municipal Inauguration Ceremony
overview: Medford convened its municipal inauguration ceremony to swear in the mayor, City Council, and School Committee. The event featured addresses from local and federal leaders, the mayor's State of the City address, and an update on the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Processional and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Master of ceremonies and municipal recovery coach Chris Summa welcomed attendees, oversaw the processional of officials, and delivered opening remarks.

items.title: Pledge of Allegiance and Invocation
items.summary: The Medford Scouts led the Pledge of Allegiance, followed by an invocation from Rabbi Jessica Dell'Era.

items.title: Poet Laureate Reading
items.summary: Medford Poet Laureate Max Heinegg read his inaugural poem, "Begin."

items.title: Remarks from Congresswoman Clark
items.summary: U.S. Representative Katherine Clark congratulated the newly elected officials and commended Medford's local governance and civic commitment.

items.title: Remarks from Councilor Bears
items.summary: City Councilor Zac Bears announced upcoming neighborhood ward meetings and stressed collaborative public service and rebuilding civic trust.

items.title: Medford High School Project Update
items.summary: School Committee member Jenny Graham detailed progress in the MSBA process for a new high school, upcoming design milestones, and the anticipated spring 2027 debt exclusion vote.

items.title: Mayoral Oath of Office and State of the City Address
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn was sworn into office and delivered her State of the City address reviewing charter reform, zoning updates, Medford Square redevelopment, housing, and infrastructure.

items.title: City Council Oath of Office
items.summary: Assistant City Clerk Rich Eliseo administered the oath of office to the members of the Medford City Council.

items.title: Musical Performance
items.summary: Stacey Clayton performed a musical selection.

items.title: School Committee Oath of Office
items.summary: Assistant City Clerk Rich Eliseo administered the oath of office to the members of the Medford School Committee.

items.title: Closing Prayer and Adjournment
items.summary: Rabbi Jessica Dell'Era offered the benediction before the police honor guard retired the colors to conclude the ceremony.
